tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV/MCH/MCHC), with normal leukocyte and erythrocyte counts. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and distribution width are elevated, suggesting increased platelet turnover or activation. Further evaluation for underlying causes of anemia and platelet changes is recommended.
